scenes.title: A Legacy Since 1940
scenes.vo: Since nineteen forty, Pasay City has gathered around one table. Capitol. Eight decades of birthdays, weddings, and reunions, shared over pancit with the people who matter most.

scenes.title: The Old Way
scenes.vo: But behind every celebration was a mountain of work. Phone calls that never stopped. Messenger threads buried overnight. Handwritten logbooks. And the dreaded moment when two families booked the very same day.

scenes.title: Introducing
scenes.vo: Today, Capitol takes its legacy online. Introducing the Capitol Booking System. Catering, function rooms, and food delivery, unified in one elegant platform, with real-time availability and automatic conflict detection.

scenes.title: Sign In
scenes.vo: Getting started takes seconds. Sign in with a secure magic link, your Google account, or a password. New guests complete a quick profile once, so names, numbers, and saved addresses fill themselves in every time after.

scenes.title: Catering
scenes.vo: Planning an event? Choose your catering style. Buffet Packages A, B, and C each serve ten to twelve guests, with Capitol classics from Lumpiang Shanghai to Crispy Pata. Or go individually packed. Pick your dishes, set your quantities, and watch your total update live.

scenes.title: Live Calendar
scenes.vo: Then choose a date on the live booking calendar. Days already taken are blocked instantly, and every booking gets at least two days of preparation. Serve it in our function room, or deliver it to your venue. Submit, and your booking reference appears right away.

scenes.title: Function Rooms
scenes.vo: Hosting a celebration? Tour Function Rooms A and B, each welcoming up to fifty guests, with sound system, projector, air conditioning, and event coordination included. And if someone else books your date first, the calendar updates in real time. A double booking simply cannot happen.

scenes.title: Delivery
scenes.vo: Craving Capitol at home? The full menu board is one tap away. Browse by category, choose half or whole, or a pancit bilao sized for three to twenty guests. Your cart totals itself, with a flat sixty peso delivery fee.

scenes.title: QR Payment
scenes.vo: Checkout is cashless and instant. Choose QR Ph, scan with GCash, Maya, or any banking app, and your payment is verified on the spot. Prefer to pay at the door? Cash on delivery is always there.

scenes.title: Track & Manage
scenes.vo: Every order gets its own reference number. Track it from your profile, from preparing, to ready, to out for delivery, with a live map of the route to your door. Your bookings live here too, and if plans change, request to cancel or move to a new date in just a few clicks.

scenes.title: AI on Messenger
scenes.vo: Not every guest starts on the website. That's why Capitol's AI assistant answers on Facebook Messenger, day and night, in English or Filipino. It sorts every inquiry, gathers the details staff need, and never promises a price or a date it can't keep.

scenes.title: Inquiry Bot
scenes.vo: Every conversation lands in the Inquiry Bot inbox. Staff filter what needs a reply, read the full context, and answer on Messenger without ever leaving the system.

scenes.title: Operations
scenes.vo: Behind the counter, the Operations board shows today at a glance. Active deliveries, pending functions, catering requests, and open inquiries. Click any booking to update details, confirm it, or print a one-page event sheet for the kitchen.

scenes.title: Delivery & Menu
scenes.vo: Delivery orders flow into one queue, ready to assign to a rider. And when the menu changes, staff add dishes, upload photos, set prices, and hide categories. The customer menu updates instantly.

scenes.title: Rider App
scenes.vo: Riders get their own mobile workspace. Today's route, customer details, and one-tap status updates that customers see the moment they happen.

scenes.title: Analytics
scenes.vo: For management, the analytics dashboard turns every order and inquiry into insight. Where guests come from, which services they choose, and how demand is trending.

scenes.title: Built to Last
scenes.vo: Everyone sees exactly what they need. Customers, staff, managers, riders, and admins each get role-based access, secured by Supabase with row-level security, real-time sync, and an AI agent powered by Google Gemini.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.vo: Capitol Booking System. Eighty-six years of hospitality, now just one click away. Book your next celebration today.
